content.value_statement: Teams often add tests without clear scope, tooling, or coverage goals. This skill provides a practical plan for Vitest, Playwright, and CI testing.
actual_capabilities: Explains a testing pyramid with unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage ratios.
Shows Vitest setup guidance for React component and integration tests.
Shows Playwright setup guidance for browser-based end-to-end flows.
Provides coverage targets for lines, functions, branches, and statements.
Outlines CI, pre-commit, debugging, and package script testing workflows.
Documents naming, mocking, async testing, error state, and form testing patterns.
limitations: The guidance is focused on JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vitest, and Playwright projects.
Dependency versions and command names may need changes for each repository.
The skill does not run tests, inspect coverage, or modify project files by itself.
Examples are generic and need adaptation for backend, mobile, or non-Node projects.

use_cases.title: Add Tests to a New Feature
use_cases.description: Plan unit, integration, and end-to-end tests before merging a new user-facing feature.

use_cases.title: Standardize Project Coverage
use_cases.description: Define coverage targets, test commands, and CI steps for a growing JavaScript application.

use_cases.title: Improve Release Confidence
use_cases.description: Identify critical browser flows that should be protected with Playwright tests before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Test Types
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a testing plan for this feature. Separate unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, and explain what each test protects.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Vitest
prompt_templates.scenario: Project setup for unit and integration tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add Vitest and React Testing Library to this project. Include setup files, coverage targets, and example test cases.

prompt_templates.title: Design Playwright Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these user flows and choose the best Playwright tests. Prioritize high-value paths and avoid duplicate low-value coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Testing Maturity
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing test suite
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this repository testing strategy. Find coverage gaps, brittle tests, missing CI checks, and improvements for speed and reliability.

output_examples.input: A React checkout feature needs better test coverage before launch.
output: Unit tests cover price calculations, validation rules, and disabled button states.
Integration tests cover cart state, payment form behavior, and API error handling.
Playwright tests cover successful checkout, payment failure, and order confirmation.

output_examples.input: A team wants CI gates for a TypeScript web app.
output: Run linting, type checks, unit tests, and coverage checks on every pull request.
Run Playwright tests after build for critical flows only.
Upload coverage and browser reports as artifacts for review.

output_examples.input: A project has many slow and unclear tests.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends clearer test names, focused assertions, dependency mocks, and separate fast checks from full end-to-end runs.

best_practices: Start with business logic and critical user flows before testing low-risk implementation details.
Keep unit tests fast and focused, then use integration tests for behavior across boundaries.
Run fast checks before commits and reserve full browser suites for push or deployment gates.
anti_patterns: Do not rely only on end-to-end tests for behavior that unit tests can cover faster.
Do not write vague tests that only prove a component renders without checking useful behavior.
Do not chase coverage numbers while ignoring missing tests for critical failures and edge cases.

faq.question: What testing tools does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright for JavaScript and TypeScript web projects.

faq.question: Can it help with test coverage targets?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests targets for lines, functions, branches, statements, and critical path coverage.

faq.question: Does it generate project-specific tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides strategy, examples, and prompts that should be adapted to the target codebase.

faq.question: Is it useful for CI setup?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for pull request checks, coverage runs, Playwright jobs, and report artifacts.

faq.question: Can it be used with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is structured as guidance that can support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: When should Playwright tests be used?
faq.answer: Use Playwright for critical browser flows that must work across real user interactions before release.
